# Study Time Statistics 1.3.0

## English

This release adds private daily and weekly study goals, a 28-day completion trend, goal streaks, and a review queue for ambiguous long sessions. Nothing is deleted automatically: sessions can be confirmed as quiet study or interactive reading. The yearly heatmap and 30-day/24-hour charts are denser, avoid overlapping labels, and open at the newest data on the right.

All data remains local. Existing 1.2 data migrates automatically.

Release verification passed 33 automated tests, production build checks, and a dependency audit with no known vulnerabilities.

## 中文

本版本新增完全本地的日目标与周目标、28 天达标趋势、连续达标统计，以及需人工判断的长会话复核队列。插件不会自动删除任何会话；你可以把待复核记录确认为静默学习或持续交互。年度热力图、近 30 天图和 24 小时图已压缩显示、避免标签重叠，并默认定位到最右侧的最新数据。

全部数据仍保存在本地，1.2 数据会自动迁移。

发布验证已通过 33 项自动化测试、生产构建检查及依赖安全审计，未发现已知漏洞。
